主要内容: Jim Cramer, host of 'Mad Money,' recently suggested that investors should consider buying Ulta Beauty stock despite its recent struggles. Ulta Beauty fell out of favor with investors in August, but Cramer believes it's time to buy the stock again. He pointed out that Ulta's last quarter was a disaster, but insiders are buying again, and the stock is trading at a discount relative to its growth rate. Cramer argues that Ulta is now trading closer to its value, making it an attractive buy. Ulta's stock fell nearly 30% in one day in late August after its second-quarter earnings report fell short of Wall Street's expectations. The company also reduced its outlook for next year. Cramer noted that Ulta's steep fall was partly due to its period of strong ascension, as it delivered spectacular double-digit same-store sales growth for years. However, after a huge run at the beginning of the year, the buyers seemed exhausted. Additionally, Cramer highlighted that insider selling was a notable event earlier in the year, with directors and executives selling almost $260 million worth of stock in the first quarter. This insider selling was on investors' minds when Ulta's poor second-quarter report came in. Cramer noted that insider buying is a positive sign, indicating confidence in the stock's future performance. Despite a recent decline of 2.04% to $257.43, Cramer believes Ulta is now trading closer to value territory rather than as a high-flying growth stock. He recommends buying some shares now and potentially more if the market experiences a pullback. Cramer emphasized that the stock is currently priced at 19 times next year's earnings estimates, making it an attractive buy in his view.
